column3: Mutable Dreams · Performance Garden | Kid Bunka · Performance Garden 0.32 · built with the VIBE FM SDK
Play | Six tracks of evolving music - play the garden, shape its weather
Four macros | Density, motion, colour and space shape the whole garden – they are its weather
Tone pads 1–4 | Root, fifth, third, ninth - notes, chords or arpeggios in the current key
Texture pads 5–8 | Forest, air and water; stardust follows the Biome's key
Space pads 9–12 | Bloom, echo, grain, dusk – open the room, let it repeat, scatter it, darken it
Form pads 13–16 | Thin lets tracks rest, pulse breathes on the eighths, next and gesture follow
The gesture | Tap pad 16 and play textures and spaces …
The gesture | … tap 16 again: your hands loop by themselves, the lanes show them
Next | Pad 15 moves to the next of six favourite Biomes – the gesture keeps going
Variation | SHIFT + 15: the same Biome, newly seeded – SHIFT + RETURN takes it back
All 50 pages | The display at twice its size, with page controls beside it
Browser | 271 Biomes in 19 families; browse Kid Bunka's 48 worlds
Moments | On PADS: SHIFT + F stores a performance snapshot; F recalls it
Mixer | Six tracks, 24 engines - choose each track's own voice and effect sends
Filter and envelope | LP12, LP24 or LPG filtering; attack up to 8 s, decay up to 16 s
Motion | Marbles, Tides, two LFOs, links between tracks, drift between two scenes
Harmony | 13 scales, chord progressions, a bassline with its own sixteen steps
Sequencer | Euclidean rhythms, steps with rules and fills, generators, a lo-fi drum kit
Effects | The echo cave, the spore meadow, the grain cloud, the tape
Places | Where the sound goes: cave, meadow, stream, reeds, the moon pond, the singing flower
Audio input | LISTEN routes IN 1 / IN 2 through cloud, echo and room
Sing | Follow, harmony or answer: the garden plays along with your voice
Call and response | A test melody enters IN 1 and stops - the garden answers
CV and gate | CV OUT and GATE OUT follow a track; CV IN can control a macro
Mutable Dreams FM | A radio station inside the instrument; SKIP finds the next piece
Itinera | Fourteen long dreams, from thirty minutes to four hours
Journeys and banks | Chain Biomes into a journey; sixteen banks keep whole sound projects
In the studio | 30 DAW controls, MIDI learn and six dry stems in compatible hosts
Help | HOME explains the page; hold an F key to read its help
First steps | A guided tour for new players – each card moves on when you have done it
Latch and depth | SHIFT + pad keeps a pad playing; encoders A and B set how deep the rows go
Tone modes | Note, chord or arpeggio in time – SHIFT + encoder 1 on PADS
Layer and speed | SHIFT + 16 layers more moves into the loop; it plays half, double or reversed
Wander | When your hands rest, the garden plays its texture and space pads by itself
Drift | Capture two scenes, and the garden glides between them by itself
Moves | The input's loudness lifts a macro – here DENSITY
Key | Play or sing one note: it becomes the Biome's key
Hold | The cloud freezes with the input inside
Fills and bass | F1 queues a fill on SEQ RULES; the bassline plays Euclid or its own steps
Journey | Up to eight Biomes in a row, each with bars, repeats and the tracks it keeps
MIDI learn | Move a controller: a CC now moves DENSITY – or level, cutoff, a send, the drift
REC | Recording controls write a WAV when the host provides a media store
A whole instrument to explore | Sound, rhythm, performance, long dreams and the tools to make them yours
New in 0.32 | Seven animated page families, a page-turn bloom and living macro plants
